export const AppSidebar = React.memo(function AppSidebar({
    ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Sidebar>) {
    // ==================
    // # Store
    // ==================
    const permissions = useUserInfoStore((state) => state.permissions);
    const dataUser = useUserInfoStore((state) => state.data);
    const isUserLoading = useUserInfoStore((state) => state.isUserLoading);
    const isPermissionsLoading = useUserInfoStore((state) => state.isPermissionsLoading);
    const isVisitorMode = useVisitorMode();

    // ==================
    // # Context
    // ==================
    const { modalOpen, setModalOpen } = React.useContext(DefaultLayoutContext);

    // ==================
    // # Constants
    // ==================
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const tenant = getTenantFromUrl();
    const isFromBuriti = tenant === 'buriti';
    const isFromCeler = tenant === 'celer';
    const isFromMd = tenant === 'md';
    const isFromDasi = tenant === 'dasi';
    const role = dataUser.role;
    const isInvestor = typeof role === 'string' && role.startsWith('INVESTIDOR');
    const disableCountsWs = isVisitorMode || role === 'COMERCIAL_BROKER' || isInvestor;
    const canViewDueDiligence2 = canAccessDueDiligence2({
        permissions,
        role,
        isSuperuser: dataUser.is_superuser,
    });
    const canViewBrokerV4 = isBrokerV4Enabled(permissions);
    const showDueDiligence2Sidebar = shouldShowDueDiligence2Sidebar({
        canViewDueDiligence2,
        brokerV4Enabled: canViewBrokerV4,
        role,
    });
    const showMeusOficiosSidebar = !isBrokerV4OficiosCutover({
        brokerV4Enabled: canViewBrokerV4,
        role,
    });

    const isCommandPaletteOpen = useCommandPaletteStore((state) => state.isOpen);
    const setIsCommandPaletteOpen = useCommandPaletteStore((state) => state.setOpen);
    const {
        isOpen: isSupportOpen,
        openModal: openSupportModal,
        closeModal: closeSupportModal,
    } = useSupportModalStore();

    useCloseMobileSidebarOnPathnameChange();

    // ==================
    // # Changelog
    // ==================
    const { hasUnread, markAsRead } = useChangelogNotification();

    // ==================
    // # Effects
    // ==================
    const canViewGlobalSearch = canAccessGlobalSearch(permissions);
    const canCreatePrecatorio = Boolean(
        permissions?.includes(Permissions.VIEW_NOVO_PRECATORIO_MODAL),
    );

    React.useEffect(() => {
        const down = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (e.key === 'k' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) {
                e.preventDefault();
                useCommandPaletteStore.getState().togglePalette('keyboard');
            }
        };
